before: #[...] attaches attribute metadata to a declaration. #[Attribute(Attribute::TARGET_CLASS)] marks Label as a class-targeted attribute type. Label("study") records an argument; it does not automatically change how Topic behaves.

ReflectionClass inspects a known class declaration. Topic::class supplies its class-name string. getAttributes returns attribute descriptors; newInstance constructs the selected attribute object and runs its constructor. Inspect only metadata you intend to trust; construction can execute code.

Passing Label::class to getAttributes filters the returned descriptors to that known attribute class. The argument is a class-name String, not a request to instantiate the attribute; newInstance performs construction separately.
Expected output or behavior: study. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.
